issues: Slide 1: The cover's background is a zoomed-in crop of the IMF map. The chart title and subtitle are cut off at the top and left ("n rate among IMF members (Apr 20", "here inflation exceeds 100pc"). The map's own credit line ("…national Monetary Fund • Created with Datawrapper") is half hidden behind the @khabarbawaal handle and the Source line. The result looks messy. Use a cleaner crop, or the full map as on slide 2.

issues: Slide 1: Only slide1.jpg exists, so I checked just that one. Its text is clean and readable, and it doesn't cover any face. The illustration doesn't match how Maa Shailputri is usually shown. She normally holds a trident and a lotus and rides a bull (Vrishabha). Here she holds neither, and the animal in the corridor looks like a cow. Devotional followers may notice. Consider a more accurate image, or at least check that it's acceptable. The 'AI illustration' label is present, which is good.

headline: Gita 1.1: Ek andha raja... aur ek sawaal
caption:

issues: Fact corrected to match the article: The lesson comes from 'mamakah' and 'pandavah' in the shlok, not from its first word, which is 'dharmakshetre'. Saying 'shabd' is inaccurate.

Slide 4: The text is about King Dhritarashtra and the words 'mere' and 'Pandu ke'. The picture shows Krishna and a young man looking at a smartphone. It doesn't match the text, and the phone doesn't belong in the Mahabharata. The same picture runs through slides 4 to 7. I'd consider swapping in the king-and-Sanjay picture.
Slide 7: Slide 7 is an exact duplicate of slide 6, so it is dropped.
